reader.requirement: At --std 85 the first print line of a body group (CH, DE, CF) is placed: a) A R / NP R on its absolute integer; b) R only: LINE-COUNTER >= FIRST DETAIL with no body group yet on the page -> LINE-COUNTER + 1 (the saved-next-group-integer case), >= FIRST DETAIL after a body group -> LINE-COUNTER + integer-2, < FIRST DETAIL -> the FIRST DETAIL line; c) no LINE clause -> not presented; d) unpaged -> LINE-COUNTER + integer-2.

edition-consulted.switches: DialectBehavior.SavedNextGroupForcesPageAdvance (active from 2002): at 85 a saved absolute NEXT GROUP integer is read only after a failed fit test (3a/3b/3c) instead of forcing the page advance
DialectBehavior.TerminateDiscardsSavedNextGroup (active from 2002): at 85 TERMINATE keeps the saved next group integer for the control footings it produces
answers each DialectBehavior question by the edition year baked into the report engine (ReportWriter.Edition, emitted by ReportWriterEmitter.EmitReportConstruction from DialectLevel)

reader.edition-search: FirstLineTarget, PresentLines and PresentLine consult no edition (read whole); grep of ReportWriter.cs for Edition/DialectBehaviors finds the two saved-next-group switches above and three others (sum size error, group indicate, control values for page groups) that do not touch first-line placement.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: only on the saved-next-group path - at 85 a body group that still fits after an absolute NEXT GROUP filled the save location is presented on the current page (CF LINE PLUS 0 at LINE-COUNTER 25 -> line 25 of page 1), while 2023 forces the page advance (same probe: page 2 line 7). The 4a/4b/4c/4d placements are the same code at every edition.

reader.notes: FirstLineTarget's body arm (_firstBodyOnPage ? FIRST DETAIL : LINE-COUNTER + integer-2) and PlaceAfterSavedNextGroup (saved + 1, or the absolute integer after the re-applied 3a test) realize every arm of GR4. LINE-COUNTER >= FIRST DETAIL with no body group on the page arises only from the saved integer, since §1985:XIII.3.10.6 GR4 keeps a report heading's NEXT GROUP below FIRST DETAIL. Outside this slice: at --std 2023 p6sav's TERMINATE CF LINE PLUS 0 overprints the detail line (F22), not judged here.

refuter.evidence: Read §1985:XIII.3.10.8 rules 3-6 whole, the PAGE clause defaults (§1985:XIII.3.8.4 GR2b: FIRST DETAIL defaults to HEADING) and the region rules (SR8a/b: a report heading not on a page by itself and a page heading must end by FIRST DETAIL - 1; §1985:XIII.3.10.6 GR4a/4b: a report heading's NEXT GROUP stays below FIRST DETAIL). So the only way LINE-COUNTER reaches FIRST DETAIL with no body group on the page is the saved next group integer, and FirstLineTarget's `_firstBodyOnPage ? FIRST DETAIL : LC + integer` matches the GR4b paragraphs. Only the RWCS changes LINE-COUNTER (§1985:XIII.3.5.6 rule 2).
